caption: The drawing features nine distinct objects arranged symmetrically on a beige or light tan background. These objects are of varying sizes and generally circular, except for two that have an oval or slightly elongated shape. The largest object is positioned at the center and is predominantly gold or brass-colored, intricately decorated with a floral or geometric pattern around a central area of small convex circles. Surrounding this central object are eight smaller objects: three above, three below, and one on each side, with spacing that forms a loose vertical alignment. Each smaller object displays unique decorative patterns and colors, including shades of gray, blue, gold, brown, and purple. Several of these objects are metallic or jeweled in appearance, with fine detailing suggesting filigree or inlaid stones. The objects cast faint shadows to their lower right, implying a light source from the upper left. In the lower left corner of the image, the name "JOHN H. TERCUZZI." is inscribed in small, capitalized letters.
title: Nine Metal Buttons
